# RFCs

The design documents of the extensions, one per change worth arguing about
before it is written. BatleHub's own RFCs live in that repository
(`batleforc/batlehub/docs/rfc/`); this series is the extensions', numbered
from 0001. A new one: `task rfc:new TITLE="…" SETTLES="…"` (the template is
`docs/internal/0000-rfc-template.md`); the table and the sidebar below are
generated from each document's header table by `task rfc:index`, and
`task rfc:index:check` fails the docs build when they have drifted.

<!-- BEGIN rfc-index — generated by `task rfc:index` from each RFC's header table — do not edit by hand -->

Of the one below, one is accepted.

**In the works** — none proposals still being written or reviewed.

**Ready to build** — one accepted and waiting to be built.

| RFC | Status | What it settles |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [0001 — Java extensions](/rfc/0001-java-env) | Accepted | How BatleHub closes the gap between VS Code and IntelliJ IDEA for Java: one core extension that orchestrates the Red Hat language stack and adds what it lacks, the contract a later satellite plugs into, and what is deliberately deferred to its own RFC |

**Settled** — none implemented, rejected or superseded: history rather than proposals.
